name: Courser Antlers
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The courser wears the mightiest antlers in the known lands.  Such antlers are used to defend the courser, goring an attacker and often damaging the points.  Perfect, natural antlers are the sign of an animal spirit with supreme confidence.

To hold such antlers will bestow the same confidence in you.

Hunt the mosshoof courser, find the perfect antlers and bring them to me.
narrative.objectives: Bring a pair of Perfect Courser Antlers to Ogtinc in Azshara.  Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast of the Ruins of Eldarath.
narrative.offerRewardText: You must possess keen sight and great patience to have obtained these. Well done.
